changelog: v1.1.5 - Attendance notification is now a real Samsung/Android Live Notification pill, and push notifications always reach the tray
features: Attendance notification now uses Android's own Live Notification pill (Samsung's "Live notifications") instead of a custom card - drawn by the system itself, with a live chronometer
Push notifications now always show in the notification tray, even while the app is open - not just as an in-app banner
Update check no longer re-downloads an already-downloaded version if you close the sheet before installing
Notification fix: push notifications now reach your phone for leave approvals, holidays, payslips, document status, and broadcasts
Attendance fix: punch-in/out time and "hours worked today" now show correctly
